tushare.recommendedSubsetRule: Ascending security code, first 20, explicitly labeled; no performance ranking.

observedRevisionAmbiguity.policy: Quarantine conflicting field/disclosure as null; retain audit sample/count/hash.

completedResearch.artifactVisibility: Private operator validation report; not a published recommendation.

logicalDatabases.PCD: Public Company Disclosure: original company facts, evidence and versions
logicalDatabases.MKT: Market & Price: prices, volumes, quotes and FX
logicalDatabases.EXT: External Research & Estimates: external research, consensus and third-party estimates
logicalDatabases.MODEL: Internal Calculations & Models: calculations, forecasts, valuations and scenarios

FD.architectureConfirmation: User confirmed; existing Atlas PCD architecture document corroborates the four logical ownership boundaries.
FD.servingLayer: Combined query layer, not a fifth fact database.
FD.vendorFinancialAdapter: Tushare fina_indicator, income, balancesheet and cashflow are vendor interfaces, not a fifth database.
FD.compatibilityNamespace: Existing fd_ formula aliases and FD filter keys identify compatibility names for vendor financial fields; they do not define FinancialDB ownership.
FD.physicalTopology: Four logical databases do not imply four independently deployed servers.
FD.memoryBoundary: Memory DB holds methods/preferences, not current financial facts.

limitations: Interface reachability, schema inventory, observed values, historical point-in-time coverage and completed research are separate evidence.
No credentials, numeric company facts or raw licensed prices are included in this metadata artifact.

fourDatabaseAliasValidation.sourceRecordRequirement: nonblank source and path for each external alias
